'''Winter Dawn''' is a [[wolf]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Winter Dawn}}

==Activities==
Winter Dawn, [[Smoke]] and [[Two Deer]] are wolves known by [[Perrin Aybara]]. When [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Hurin]] and [[Loial]] disappear from [[Ingtar Shinowa]]'s camp, Perrin asks the wolves to help them search for the [[Horn of Valere]], which was stolen by [[Padan Fain]].{{ref/book|2|14}}
